note: Lane exec_guards: the browser-facing guards of an interface that can place orders (app/core/websec.py, tests/test_websec.py), graded over HTTP on both desks. The instrument guards, product gates, risk ledger and limiters have no route of their own; they are graded in Rust unit tests (src/lanes/exec_core/exec_guards/tests_*.rs) and through /execute by desk_cases/exec_gateway.json. Every case leaves the replay Kite's order/GTT log empty.
